name: Jiangnan Tower
description:
Acts as a tax drop-off for Imperial Officials.
Military Buildings and Military Units produced within influence award progress towards free armies. Each free army requires progressively more resources to be spent than the last, until 12 armies have been produced.
descriptionCN:
可作为朝廷命官的税金存放点使用。
在影响范围内生产的军事建筑和军事单位可提升免费军队的进度。每个免费军队都逐渐需要比前一支军队消耗更多的资源，直到生产 12 支军队。
